title: Attractap Setup
subtitle: Install firmware and configure your reader

connect.title: Connect your Attractap
connect.description: Plug your Attractap into a USB port, then click connect and pick the correct serial port in the browser dialog.
connect.bleBridgeHint: Installing firmware on an Attractap BLE Bridge (GL.iNet GL-S10)? Connect your 3.3 V USB-TTL adapter instead and put the bridge into download mode first.

bluetooth.hint: Already flashed and not paired yet? Set it up without a cable while its Bluetooth setup is open. An Attractap Touch opens it for 10 minutes after it starts, or with the "Bluetooth setup" button on its screen. An Attractap Lite opens it for 10 minutes after power-up (its ring pulses blue twice). A BLE Bridge opens it when you hold its button for 3 seconds (the Bluetooth LED double-flashes; holding it for 10 seconds resets the bridge).

unavailable.title: Bluetooth setup is not available in this browser
unavailable.description: Setting up over Bluetooth needs Web Bluetooth, which Chrome and Edge offer on a computer and Chrome offers on Android (over HTTPS). Open this page there, or connect the device via USB, which also needs Chrome or Edge on a computer.

blocked.title: Bluetooth is blocked for this site
blocked.description: The browser did not open its device list because Bluetooth is blocked for this site. Click the icon left of the address, open the site settings and set Bluetooth (or Bluetooth devices) to Allow, then reload the page and try again. If that setting is missing, check that sites may ask to use Bluetooth devices in the browser settings (Privacy and security → Site settings) and that your organisation does not block Web Bluetooth. In Brave, Web Bluetooth is off by default: open brave://flags/#brave-web-bluetooth-api, set Web Bluetooth API to Enabled and relaunch the browser. Or set the device up via USB.

failed.title: Could not connect over Bluetooth
failed.description: Make sure the device's Bluetooth setup is still open (it closes after 10 minutes) and keep it close to this computer or phone. If your computer asks to pair over Bluetooth, accept the request. In the browser list, pick the right device (an Attractap Touch shows its name on its screen), then try again. If it keeps failing, set it up via USB.

lost.title: Bluetooth connection lost
lost.description: The device dropped the connection: it was out of range, restarted or its 10-minute setup window closed. Settings you had not saved yet are gone. If it is not paired yet, open its Bluetooth setup again (see above) and connect again.

closedAfterPairing.title: Setup complete
closedAfterPairing.description: The device is connected to Attraccess and closed its Bluetooth connection, as expected.
